Superstring theory is known to be ultraviolet finite, meaning it does not suffer from the high-energy divergences that plague quantum field theories like Quantum Chromodynamics (A) and Quantum Electrodynamics (C). Classical Electrodynamics (B) also encounters infinities, such as the infinite self-energy of a point charge, which historically required some form of regularization or cutoff. Therefore, Superstring Theory is the only option that never requires regularization at high energies.
